create_poincare_maps: create a PoincareMaps object from 2D coordinates to compute distances, detect lineages, and plot the Poincare disc
compute_poincare_distance: compute pairwise Poincare distances between points using the poincare_distance function with a PyTorch tensor
plot_poincare_disc: plot a Poincare disc scatter plot with optional labels, colors, and geodesic arcs using plot_poincare_disc
read_data_csv: read a CSV dataset with optional label column, normalization, and PCA dimensionality reduction using read_data
generate_poincare_linspace: generate interpolated points along a Poincare geodesic between two points using poincare_linspace
